rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Maximum Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Your landlord can only raise your rent by a limited amount each year, based on a percentage cap or a portion of CPI, whichever is less. The current maximum allowable increase is 2.87% for September 2026 through August 2027.
rules.key_value: Lesser of 3% or 80% of CPI change (currently 2.87% for 9/1/2026-8/31/2027)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: The increase cannot be more than 3% of your current rent or 80% of the Consumer Price Index (CPI) change, whichever is less.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Just Cause Protections
rules.requirement: Landlords must have a valid, legally recognized reason to evict a tenant, such as non-payment of rent, lease violations, or owner move-in. Tenants evicted for certain no-fault reasons may be entitled to relocation assistance.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: Your landlord must have a valid reason to evict you. This could be for not paying rent, breaking the lease, or if the landlord wants to move into the property themselves.

rules.title: Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance - Registration Fee Pass-Through Cap
rules.requirement: Landlords may pass through a registration fee to tenants but cannot charge more than $50 per rental unit; if they overcharge, they must reimburse the tenant the overpayment.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units covered by the Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance where landlord charges a pass-through registration fee.
rules.citation: Santa Ana Rent Stabilization and Just Cause Eviction Ordinance
rules.quoted_span: If a landlord charges a tenant a pass-through fee greater than $50, the landlord shall reimburse the tenant for the registration fee pass-through overpayment.
